summary: CAE Inc. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on May 21, 2026, solely to furnish the notice of its Annual General Meeting. The filing states the record date for notice and voting is June 15, 2026, the meeting date is August 12, 2026, and it will be a hybrid meeting. The registrant is a Canadian issuer furnishing the report under Rule 13a-16. No special-situation transaction is referenced. This is a routine procedural filing equivalent to the US preliminary or definitive proxy material notice window.
